author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260511T170438Z-856615
text:
Resolution: landed workspace bench convention + canonical example in crate-jmap-server.

Concrete artifacts:
- crate-jmap-server/Cargo.toml: added criterion 0.8 dev-dep + [[bench]] entry for "dispatcher".
- crate-jmap-server/benches/dispatcher.rs: 3 benches covering the parse + resolve hot path.
  * parse_request_three_calls: ~3.9 µs/op
  * resolve_args_ids_star: ~1.9 µs/op (ResultReference + /ids/* wildcard)
  * resolve_args_no_refs_fast_path: ~346 ns/op (early-return path)
- Bench inputs are hand-built JSON Values modeled on RFC 8620 §3 + Fastmail samples (workspace memory `jmap-ids-result-reference-path-fastmail-official-samples`).
- Pattern uses std::hint::black_box (criterion::black_box is deprecated in 0.8) and harness=false so cargo bench picks up criterion's harness.

Workspace state: 1 of 25 crates now has benches/. Follow-up beads filed for the other two "worth considering for" crates from this bead's description:
- JMAP-sc1b.105: criterion benches/ for crate-jmap-mime (parser hot path).
- JMAP-sc1b.106: criterion benches/ for crate-jmap-base-client (session URL/JSON serde).

Both follow-ups land at P3 because the canonical pattern is now established and replication is mechanical. Convention captured in workspace memory `workspace-criterion-bench-pattern`.
